column1: # prepush-twins.tsv — the twin table for conformance/prepush-lane.sh (PREPUSH-CI-PARITY).
# TAB-SEPARATED, SEVEN COLUMNS, in this order (a `#` line and a blank line are ignored):
#   1 basename   the check, WITHOUT `conformance/` and WITHOUT `.sh`; [a-z0-9-]+; conformance/<it>.sh
#                must be a regular file under the repo root.
#   3 ci-shape   a literal SUBSTRING of the physical ci.yml line this row accounts. Accounting is by
#                SHAPE, never by basename alone (security C19): a second, differently-shaped
#                invocation of the same check stays UNACCOUNTED until it gets its own row.
#   4 local-argv the argv the lane runs LOCALLY (twin) / `NAME=value` (env). Empty for exclude+heavy.
#   5 expect-rc  the rc the local run must produce (twin; integer or blank elsewhere).
#   6 budget-s   integer wall-clock ceiling in seconds — REQUIRED on `heavy`, blank elsewhere.
#   7 reason     free text, no tab. REQUIRED on `exclude` (and always worth writing).
#   twin    — a context line -> its local argv. Accounts the mention by ci-shape. Needs 3, 4, 5.
#   exclude — accounted, never executed (CI-only, disabled in CI, a heredoc/echo/grep mention).
#   heavy   — annotates an invocation ALREADY in the census numerator as too slow for the core.
#             Accounts NOTHING (a heavy row can never hide a mention). Needs 6.
#   env     — one literal NAME=value a single derived check may receive. Accounts nothing.
#             local-argv matches ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*=[A-Za-z0-9._/=-]+$ and the NAME must not be
#             on the §3.1 sensitive list. No `env` row is needed today; the column contract stands.
# `local-argv` GRAMMAR: the §3.1 invocation grammar (the scanner's own validator judges it), plus a
# CLOSED placeholder set — {listing} {branch} {base-board} {head}. Any other `{`, or a `$`, backtick
# or quote, REDS the census and the row is never executed. Placeholders are substituted into
# POSITIONAL PARAMETERS (`set --`), never into a string: a branch named `x;$(touch /tmp/pwned)`
# yields exactly one literal token and no file.
# `read_twins` exposes each valid row downstream (task 3's runner) in this same tab-separated shape.
# A STALE row — one whose ci-shape matches no denominator line — REDS the census: this table may
# never outlive the ci.yml it describes.
